upstream.note: Structured incident metadata + factual summaries; every row deep-links the original.

incidents.title: Adire Law Office: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. The Adire Law Office disclosed that its website email service provider’s server was accessed without authorization in mid‑November, resulting in the leakage of over 1,800 personal records. The firm confirmed the breach and is notifying affected individuals. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Enara Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Enara Health reported a data breach affecting 5,066 individuals, confirmed via regulatory filing on November 26. United States.

Shtip, North Macedonia.

incidents.victim: CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence

incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Hackers accessed systems used by the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence for open source intelligence. US authorities say no classified documents were compromised and the vulnerability has been patched. United States.

incidents.title: 1Password: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. 1Password disclosed that an unknown attacker accessed a corporate GitHub account and stole limited customer information and source code. The company confirmed that no vault secrets were accessed and that the breach was contained. Toronto, Canada.

incidents.title: Flight Centre Travel Group: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Flight Centre Travel Group confirmed an investigation into unauthorized activity within a third-party booking system that potentially exposed customer records across multiple leisure brands in Australia. Shares fell 2% in early trade. Brisbane, Australia.

incidents.title: Korea Investment Savings Bank: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Korea Investment Savings Bank experienced a hacking incident that leaked personal data of 86,611 customers. The bank confirmed the breach on November 24 and stated that financial transaction details were not compromised. South Korea.

incidents.title: Outlet Plaza Co.: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Outlet Plaza Co., Ltd. announced that unauthorized external access to its e‑commerce sites resulted in a leak of customer membership information, including names, addresses, and phone numbers. The company confirmed that credit card information was not leaked and that the number of affected customers has not been disclosed. Japan.

incidents.title: ESAGAMES: Confirmed DDoS attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. ESAGAMES was hit by a multi‑terabit DDoS campaign targeting one of its customers. The company confirmed the attack reached over 5 Tbps and that the customer remained online after mitigation. Germany.
